name: Bicycle Crunch
summary: A rotational crunch that trains the abs and obliques.
setup: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Place your fingertips lightly behind your head.
Press your lower back toward the floor and brace the abs.
execution: Lift your head and shoulders and bring your legs up.
Rotate your torso to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg.
Switch sides in a smooth pedaling motion.
Keep your elbows wide and avoid pulling on your neck.
mistakes: Pulling on the neck: keep hands light and lead with the chest.
Rushing the reps: slow down and rotate fully.
Lower back arching: lower the legs less or keep the feet higher.
Only moving the elbows: turn the shoulders toward the knee.
